epics.title: Personal AI Regulatory Assistant & GOST Order Generator
epics.jtbd: When an educational administrator, instructor, or resident needs regulatory guidance or administrative drafts, I want an AI assistant grounded in institutional knowledge and a one-click GOST R 7.0.97-2016 .docx order generator, so that official administrative tasks are executed accurately in seconds.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Document generation error rate < 0.1% and 100% elimination of external brand leaks
epics.tocConstraintRef: crie_assistant_api.py document export & session continuity pipeline
requirements: R1: Eliminate UI abstraction leaks by purging DeepSeek branding, replacing hardcoded 1713 document counters with dynamic index counts, and enforcing institutional FBUN CRIE branding
R2: Ensure temporal chat continuity by binding conversation sessions to browser localStorage and synchronizing with backend session state
R3: Implement dynamic multi-format document generator endpoints for Word, Excel, and PDF (/api/generate/docx, /api/generate/xlsx, /api/generate/pdf)
R4: Replace static 15-document mock download with dynamic targeted bundle packaging archive generation based on user query/selection
R5: Automated regression and integration test coverage across multi-format export, session persistence, and branding sanitization

slices.title: Direct patch for autopoietic continuity, multi-format export, and institutional branding
slices.jtbd: When implementing autopoietic evolution for this epic, I want to purge branding leaks, persist chat sessions, expose multi-format generation endpoints, and generate dynamic archives, so that the assistant operates as an autonomous institutional tool without static mock bottlenecks.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the existing web interface and API, When the user inspects headers and counters, Then no DeepSeek branding is displayed and document counts reflect real indexed catalog totals.
Given an active chat conversation, When the page is reloaded or session restored, Then messages and document drafts persist across localStorage and backend session state.
Given requests to /api/generate/docx, /api/generate/xlsx, and /api/generate/pdf, When valid academic/regulatory parameters are supplied, Then standard-compliant DOCX, XLSX, and PDF binaries are dynamically compiled and returned.
Given a download request for a targeted bundle, When filtered parameters are submitted, Then a dynamically assembled ZIP package containing only matching documents is produced.
slices.tocConstraintRef: crie_assistant_api.py document routing and generation handlers
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero brand leakage incidents and 100% valid multi-format HTTP status 200 responses

slices.title: Pyramid verification for multi-format document endpoints, chat continuity, and archive bundling
slices.jtbd: When implementing verification for this epic, I want comprehensive unit, integration, and journey test suites, so that branding compliance, session durability, and document generation integrity are guaranteed.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given unit tests for document generation, When DOCX, XLSX, and PDF builders execute, Then files are structurally valid and contain zero third-party branding leaks.
Given integration tests for /api/generate/* and archive bundle endpoints, When concurrent client requests execute, Then valid MIME types and Content-Disposition headers are returned with sub-second latency.
Given an E2E journey test on chat continuity, When a session is initiated, messages sent, and browser context reloaded, Then the session state is faithfully reconstructed from localStorage and backend cache.
slices.tocConstraintRef: QA verification test harness in tests/test_autopoietic_continuity.py
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% test pass rate across unit, integration, and E2E pyramid layers
